evidence.dominant_driver: Richmond Fed President Tom Barkin says the Fed hiked because inflation risks outweigh employment risks, economic conditions are firming, and tariff/energy shocks are not fading.

market_expectations.expected_value: Another Fed hike remained a live scenario; Barkin reinforces rather than originates the hawkish regime.
market_expectations.distribution_notes: Reuters reported about 53.1% odds of another hike at the next meeting.

absorption.reason: Nearly two hours elapsed. Nasdaq stayed near record highs and Treasury yields fell with oil, while gold/dollar reflected more of the hawkish message.

observations.interpretation: Dollar/gold confirm hawkishness, but yields, oil and tech equities reject an immediate broad risk-off call.

evidence.decision_notes: Residual forecast from decision time; learning_profile.json is empty, so no learning adjustment applied.

regimes.equities: Nasdaq at/near intraday record; S&P mixed/slightly softer, no broad risk-off
regimes.rates: yields lower as oil retreat offsets Fed hawkishness
regimes.energy: oil sharply lower on Middle-East diplomacy/supply optimism

next_session.rationale: If front-end yields reprice higher as Barkin's inflation warning is absorbed, duration-heavy tech is vulnerable next session.
